name: SRM Institute of Science and Technology
officialName: SRM Institute of Science and Technology (SRMIST), Kattankulathur
summary: SRMIST (formerly SRM University) was established in 1985 by its founder chancellor Dr T. R. Paarivendhar. Its main campus at Kattankulathur, on Chennai's southern edge, spreads over 250+ acres. It was accredited A++ by NAAC in its fourth cycle (2024–2031) and ranked 22nd overall and 11th among universities in NIRF 2025. B.Tech admission is through its own entrance test, SRMJEEE, held in three phases; arts, science and commerce degrees admit on Class XII marks.

testing.notes: For B.Tech. Held in three phases; you may sit more than one.
